This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is FIRST application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail filed by the applicant- Hukum Singh who is in custody since 21.04.2023 in connection with Crime No.18/2020 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Sajapur for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the IPC.
A s per prosecution case, at the relevant time this applicant was the Manager of Pathamik Krishi Sakh Sahkari Samiti Maryadit Dharakhedi.

sentences.text: His son obtained the loan of Rs.84,530/- by forging the documents.
By misusing his official position he got released the loan and thereafter granted the benefit of Jai Kisan Rin Mafi Yojna.
After reporting the matter he was arrested.
The amount of Rs.84,530/- has been deposited on the pretext of mistake on the part of computer operator.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
